messages:
sam: Alert — fncall_schema_rejects up on route=canary-apac, mainly invoice_tool. Spike started ~5m ago.

anya: Can you grab a sample?

sam: From logs: ```{"tool":"invoice_tool","out":"{\"invoice\":{\"id\":123,\"amount\":19.99}}"}``` validator expected strings and currency field.

morgan: Looks like nested JSON encoded as string + numeric types. Is this model_variant=v3-quant?

sam: yes v3-quant on canary-apac. runtime uses permissive tokenization.

anya: Quick wins: 1) add nested-string reparsing up to depth 2 in fncall validator behind canary flag; 2) soft-coerce numbers->strings for id/amount during soft-validate; 3) emit metrics for parsed_fix and coercion_event so console can show both.

observability-bot: current validation_sample_rate=0.01. I can bump to 0.1 for route=canary-apac for 30m. Alert rule `canary_apac_fncall_rejects` created at threshold >20/min with annotation to link samples.

console-product: We need stacked metrics (rejects / parsed_fix / coerced_fix) on the console so PMs and on-call know if it's fixable. Also surface model_variant next to route filter.

devops-bot: deployment note: any parser changes must be feature-flagged and have fail-open semantics. If reparsing crashes we must not block the request.

anya: I'll PR the reparsing patch with a feature flag and raw_sample emission when we alter payloads. Morgan can add coercion metric.

morgan: on it. Will add labels {route, model_variant} to metrics.

sam: owners: anya (reparse PR), morgan (coercion metric), observability (sample rate & alert), console-product (dashboard). Aim: mitigations in 60m, rollback if rejects stay high after that.

observability-bot: Sample rate adjusted to 10% for routes matching canary-apac for 30 minutes.

sam: thanks — monitoring now. If anyone sees new errors post-reparse rollout, ping immediately.
